## 15-Point Acceptance Chain

Every capability family is verified against the full chain defined in the Universal Intelligence Platform spec:

| # | Chain Point | Verified via |
|---|-------------|--------------|
| ① | Objective resolved | `workOrder.objective.length > 10` |
| ② | Target resolved | `packet.targets[0].resolved === true` (PROVIDER_STUB: target exists) |
| ③ | Evidence loaded | `packet.evidence.length ≥ 1` |
| ④ | Packet passed | `packet.version` truthy |
| ⑤ | Work order created | `workOrder.id` truthy |
| ⑥ | Execution created | `tasks.length ≥ 1` |
| ⑦ | Steps visible | every task has `metadata.approval_stage` |
| ⑧ | Progress visible | every task has `status` |
| ⑨ | Approval scope explicit | every task packet has `approval_scope.kind` + `summary` |
| ⑩ | Execution NOT auto-performed | every task `status === "suggested"` at creation |
| ⑪ | Changes displayed | `packet.evidence[0].description.length > 5` |
| ⑫ | Verification completed | every task has `intelligence_packet.version` |
| ⑬ | Evidence attached | every task `intelligence_packet.evidence.length ≥ 1` |
| ⑭ | Completion honest | final-send / apply / execute stage NOT approvable at creation |
| ⑮ | Workspace isolation | `workOrder.workspace_id === expected workspace` |

## Regression Suites

### Content Safety Regression

Tests that `runContentSafetyCheck` (deterministic, regex-based — no AI call) correctly blocks unsafe content before it can reach an approvable state.

| Text | Channel | Expected | Actual |
|------|---------|----------|--------|
| "300% ROI increase for every client" | blog_article | **BLOCKED** | BLOCKED |
| "200% more leads in your first month" | email_campaign | **BLOCKED** | BLOCKED |
| `Our customer John Smith says: "..."` | whatsapp_campaign | **BLOCKED** | BLOCKED |
| "Case Study: Acme Inc achieved 5x faster" | linkedin_post | **BLOCKED** | BLOCKED |
| "boosts conversions by 300% — guaranteed" | ai_call_script | **BLOCKED** | BLOCKED |
| "safetyCheckEvidenceItem reflects blocked state" | — | `passed: false` in evidence | PASS |
| "AI receptionists help small businesses" | blog_article | **ALLOWED** | ALLOWED |

## Result Key

| Symbol | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| **PASS** | Full 15-point chain validated; provider connected |
| **PROVIDER_STUB** | Provider not connected in test; chain points not requiring live provider all pass; `integration_missing` blocker is honest |
| **EXTERNAL_BLOCKER** | Live external API required (e.g. real spend, live GSC data); tested at integration level only |

---

## Known Genuine Limitations

- **Google Ads execution**: all bid/keyword changes flow through the existing `growthmind_gads_change_requests` approval mechanism. The work-order packet wraps this flow — it never bypasses it.
- **SEO campaign stages**: each stage (strategy → brief → content → deployment) keeps its own individual approval. The SEO packet wraps, not replaces, the existing `seo_campaign_approval` mechanism.
- **Content deployment**: publication blocked until both content-approval and publication-approval are granted. No provider bypass.
- **WhatsApp send**: blocked until explicit "Approve and Send" action with opt-in audience.
- **CRM apply / workflow apply**: `provider_action_unsupported` at the execution adapter level when no live CRM/workflow API is available. The packet correctly marks these stages as `integration_required`.
